Method of Attack: Android banking trojan disguised as copies of official banking apps or inside other apps to phish banking credentials and two-step verification codes by intercepting SMS messages
Attack Vector: Distribution via third-party app stores and underground hacking forums; malware hidden inside legitimate-looking apps; advertising on underground hacking forums
Indicators of Compromise: Ads on Russian-speaking underground hacking forums
Infections of over one million Android devices in Russia
Use of over 6,000 bank accounts to launder money
Campaign preparations targeting French banks with Tiny.z
